stem:
A student investigates the refraction of white light entering a transparent rectangular block. A narrow beam of light enters the block at the midpoint of one of the shorter sides. The angle of incidence *θ* is measured, as shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The distance *d* between the corner of the block and the point where the beam of light touches the boundary of the block is measured.

The experiment is repeated for different values of *θ*.

It is suggested that *d* and *θ* are related by the equation

$\frac{B}{B + d^2} = \frac{\sin^2 θ}{n^2}$

where *B* and *n* are constants.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of *d*² on the *y*-axis against 1 / sin² *θ* on the *x*-axis.

Determine expressions for the gradient and *y*-intercept.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *θ*, 1 / sin² *θ* and *d* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

Calculate and record values of *d*² / cm² in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in *d*².

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Plot a graph of *d*² / cm² against 1 / sin² *θ*. Include error bars for *d*².

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the *y*-intercept of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (c)(iv), determine the values of *B* and *n*. Include appropriate units.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the angle *θ* that gives a value of *d* of 30.0 cm.

figures.caption: Fig. 2.1
figures.alt: A ray of light enters a rectangular block at its left side and travels diagonally to the lower boundary, with the angle of incidence θ and distance d marked.

figures.caption: Table 2.1
figures.alt: A table with columns for θ / °, 1 / sin² θ, d / cm and d² / cm², with six rows of given measurements and an empty final column.
A blank graph grid with d² / cm² on the vertical axis and 1 / sin² θ on the horizontal axis.
